easyPrerequisites: An opponent controls as many or more creatures as you do.
description:
Cast Swords to Plowshares using the convoke ability from Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia by tapping Emeritus of Truce.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emeritus of Truce, which enters prepared.
Resolve Swords to Plowshares.
Repeat.

uses.name: Emeritus of Truce // Swords to Plowshares
Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia
